output.summary: A user with ulcerative colitis on mesalamine tablets described urgency, 6-7 bowel movements a day and some blood, and said they had been told this was normal. The bot explained that this suggests undertreated disease and covered step-up options including rectal mesalamine, how to speed up a GI referral, calprotectin testing, coping tips and checking before using loperamide. The user said they felt ashamed at the start and ended with a plan and feeling able to act.
